column1: # Format:  trigger phrase <TAB> terms appended to the retrieval query
# Engineers name procedures the way they discuss them; specs name them the way
# they are titled, and the gap is large enough to change the answer. Measured on
#     "initial attach procedure E-UTRAN EPS"  → 23.401 at rank 1, score 0.991
# Same spec, same index — only the wording differed.
# The trigger is matched as a lowercase substring of the procedure name. Matched
# terms are APPENDED to the query, never substituted, so the caller's own wording
# still contributes and a wrong match degrades to mild query dilution rather than
# to a different procedure being retrieved.
# This affects getProcedureFlow only, not search3gpp.
# NOTE ON MEASUREMENT: "eps attach" below overlaps an entry in the 10-procedure
# eval set, so that item's improvement is partly by construction. The other nine
# entries act as the regression check — coverage there must not drop.
